outside_window.finding: Kazakhstan's 2026 Tax Code replaced the flat 7.5% gold mineral extraction tax with a price-linked scale that reaches 11% at $3,800/oz. Gold averaged above $4,000 all through H1 2026 (realised price $4,809 in Q1, $4,459 in Q2), so H1 2026 carries roughly 3.5pp more MET on about US$115m of revenue, around US$4m, or 6-7% of an H1 pre-tax profit I estimate near US$60m. None of AltynGold's 2026 RNSs mentions it. Original (uchet.kz): 'При среднебиржевой цене 3800 долларов за тройскую унцию ставка составляет 11%' / 'По старой редакции Налогового кодекса была предусмотрена единая ставка 7,5%'. Translation: at an average exchange price of $3,800 per troy ounce the rate is 11%; the old Tax Code set a single 7.5% rate. This lands on reported_quarter. It is small against the gold beta, and the company's own FY2025 report already shows AISC rising from $1,357 to $1,562/oz, so a cost-creep reader has seen the direction. Sizing: -0.4 at 30% odds of an in-window release is -0.12; -0.4, range -1.5 to 0, if it does print on the 24th. Corroborated by https://mybuh.kz/news/izmeneniya-po-ndpi-s-2026-goda/ (same thresholds).

The board has said it is reviewing a dividend policy. FY2025 chairman's statement, 29 Apr 2026: 'The Board continues to review the potential introduction of a dividend policy, balancing shareholder returns with the capital and investment requirements needed to upgrade the Company's processing capacity'. Net debt was US$18.5m at YE2025, H1 2026 revenue was US$115.2m, and 2025 op cash flow was US$55.7m, so the group is probably net cash at 30 June and the interims are a natural place to announce one. The other side is that the 2-2.5Mtpa expansion is competing for the cash. Its update was promised 'by mid-year', then 'over the course of the Summer' (1 Jun RNS), then 'in the coming few months' (Q2 RNS), and it has not come. Pure option: +0.4 if the print is on the 24th (range 0 to +6), about +0.12 probability-weighted. The overdue expansion update may land alongside it with a capex and funding number, and the sign of that is not knowable today. Financing is a question, not a verdict.

language_note: Nothing the English sources did not already carry. AltynGold distributes every RNS via Business Wire (BZW), so the domestic Investegate mirror and the international wire carry identical text. The domestic mirror's value was its dated archive, which is what established the absent Notice of Results and the 25-30 Sep release pattern.

The one fact on no English or UK source, the 7.5% to 11% gold MET scale, came from Kazakh Russian-language accounting press (uchet.kz, mybuh.kz). That is the issuer's operating-country press, not a domestic-UK source, and it is recorded here so it is not credited to the UK half.
